user.title: 2N EasyGate
user.description: Serial port of the GSM gateway (straight 1:1 cable, RTS/CTS flow control).

data.baudrate: Baud rate (the gateway detects it automatically)

error.cannot_connect: The gateway does not answer on this port.
error.busy: The gateway blocks the port (not registered in the GSM network, or a call is being set up). Try again later.

data.daily_limit: Daily SMS limit (0 = only forced sending)
data.max_parts: Maximum parts of one long SMS
data.strip_diacritics: Remove diacritics (160 instead of 70 characters per SMS)
data.missed_calls: Read missed calls from the module
data.delete_sms: Archive received SMS to /config/easygate_sms.txt and delete them from the gateway
data.command_numbers: Numbers allowed to send SMS commands (event easygate_command)
data.command_pin: PIN at the start of an SMS command (recommended, e.g. 4711 HEATING ON)

send_sms.name: Send SMS
send_sms.description: Sends an SMS through the gateway, respecting the daily limit.

number.name: Number
number.description: Recipient(s); default recipients from the options when empty.

force.name: Ignore daily limit
force.description: Send even if the daily limit is reached.

at_command.name: AT command
at_command.description: Sends a raw AT command to the GSM module (for debugging).

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the answer.
